briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Gemini 3.5 clash as AGI timelines compress to 2027

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models this month. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agents. Prompt injection and multi-agent security dominate risk discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with 2.1T parameters and new chain-of-thought scaling. Google released Gemini 3.5 Ultra while xAI and DeepSeek pushed open-weight alternatives past 1T parameters.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Oracle announced new 100k H100 clusters while TSMC reports 2nm yield improvements for next-gen AI chips. Sovereign AI data centers in Europe and Middle East continue rapid expansion.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier labs before regulatory intervention freezes progress?
